title: evaluator's in
description: What the main conversation starts each evaluator with: the cut tree.py start evaluator printed, word for word, for one group of the intents.

start.description: The run values, the JSON object on the first line of the cut tree.py start printed, each a value the guard holds the role's calls to. The rest of the cut follows it.

files.description: Each file of the deliverable, as the Making record gives them, which the evaluator reads to its end.

reads.description: Each file the evaluator may read: the deliverable's files, the files it takes its content from, the try record, and its answers.

try.description: The try record, throwaway.txt in the round's folder.

answers.description: The path of its Answers, evaluator-<group>.json in the round's folder.
